sql: select name, setting from pg_settings where name in ('connection_info')
SET connection_info = '{"driver_name":"libpq","driver_version":"(GaussDB Kernel V500R001C20 build 25489f56) compiled at 2026-10-12 16:05:52 commit 0 last mr  debug"}'

SELECT oid::text,current_setting('data_directory'), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='sse_v1_catalog') FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()

SELECT c.relname,c.relkind,a.attname,a.atttypid::text,a.attnotnull, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint pk WHERE pk.conrelid=c.oid AND pk.contype='p' AND pk.conkey=ARRAY[a.attnum]) FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ($1,$2,$3)

SELECT oid::text,current_setting('data_directory'), EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='sse_v1_catalog') FROM pg_catalog.pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()

SELECT c.relname,c.relkind,a.attname,a.atttypid::text,a.attnotnull, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint pk WHERE pk.conrelid=c.oid AND pk.contype='p' AND pk.conkey=ARRAY[a.attnum]) FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ($1,$2,$3)
